tasks.label: 🧩 Build Info
tasks.command: cmd_app='${input:appName}'; cmd_region='${input:region}'; cmd_build=''; cmd_scan=''; if [ -n '${input:buildId}' ]; then cmd_build="-b${input:buildId}"; fi; if [ -n '${input:scanType}' ]; then cmd_scan="-s${input:scanType}"; fi; xml_api_cli build_info --app_name "$cmd_app" ${cmd_build:+$cmd_build} ${cmd_scan:+$cmd_scan} --region "$cmd_region"

tasks.label: 🧮 Detailed Report
tasks.command: cmd_app='${input:appName}'; cmd_format='${input:format}'; cmd_build=''; cmd_scan=''; cmd_region=''; cmd_prefix=''; cmd_out=''; if [ -n '${input:buildId}' ]; then cmd_build="-b${input:buildId}"; fi; if [ -n '${input:scanType}' ]; then cmd_scan="-s${input:scanType}"; fi; if [ -n '${input:region}' ]; then cmd_region="-r${input:region}"; fi; if [ -n '${input:prefix}' ]; then cmd_prefix="-p${input:prefix}"; fi; if [ -n '${input:outDir}' ]; then cmd_out="-o${input:outDir}"; fi; xml_api_cli detailed_report --app_name "$cmd_app" -f"$cmd_format" $cmd_build $cmd_scan $cmd_region $cmd_prefix $cmd_out

tasks.label: 💬 Summary Report
tasks.command: cmd_app='${input:appName}'; cmd_format='${input:format}'; cmd_build=''; cmd_scan=''; cmd_region=''; cmd_prefix=''; cmd_out=''; if [ -n '${input:buildId}' ]; then cmd_build="-b${input:buildId}"; fi; if [ -n '${input:scanType}' ]; then cmd_scan="-s${input:scanType}"; fi; if [ -n '${input:region}' ]; then cmd_region="-r${input:region}"; fi; if [ -n '${input:prefix}' ]; then cmd_prefix="-p${input:prefix}"; fi; if [ -n '${input:outDir}' ]; then cmd_out="-o${input:outDir}"; fi; xml_api_cli detailed_report --app_name "$cmd_app" -f"$cmd_format" $cmd_build $cmd_scan $cmd_region $cmd_prefix $cmd_out

tasks.label: 🧠 Review Mitigation Info
tasks.command: cmd_app=''; cmd_file=''; cmd_sev=''; cmd_scan=''; if [ -n '${input:appName}' ]; then cmd_app="-n${input:appName}"; fi; if [ -n '${input:file}' ]; then cmd_file="-f${input:file}"; fi; if [ -n '${input:severity}' ]; then cmd_sev="-S${input:severity}"; fi; if [ -n '${input:scanType}' ]; then cmd_scan="-s${input:scanType}"; fi; if [ -z "$cmd_app" ] && [ -z "$cmd_file" ]; then echo 'Error: Either app_name or file must be provided.'; exit 1; fi; xml_api_cli review_mitigation $cmd_app $cmd_file $cmd_sev $cmd_scan

inputs.description: Provide your existing Detailed XML Report (Optional - Fetch Latest report for App)
